question: Which state receiver do the selected loading-tip and native game-helper paths advance, and how does it differ from the main combat and synchronization state contracts?

scope.boundary: Two selected exact-entry leaf windows, two PE-bounded wrappers and accepted caller/persistence/combat contracts. No all-consumer, initialization, natural gameplay, runtime ordering, checksum or incident-cause proof.

dependencies.use: Accepted loading-tip initialization, modulo 61 table and conditional delivery.
Accepted selected input 16 caller, forwarding to 0x82D05AD0 and still-open action/row/retention/effect gates.
Accepted separate 0x82F7AD00 combat carrier, local arithmetic and guarded persistent writes.
Accepted mandatory separate scalar header transfer and guarded restoration, without duplicating the transfer proof.
Accepted main-state and separate current-data comparisons; no selected shared-state-to-mismatch causal join.
Accepted current-data projection and phase limits; a scalar projection is not all checksum coverage.

loadingTipReceiverBoundary.receiverProducer: 0x82E85108/0x82E8510C forms effective receiver low32(r3)=0x8314F750 after required initialization return; no unqualified full64 pointer equality is asserted.
loadingTipReceiverBoundary.orderedWrites: 0x821BE86C stores low32(C+1); 0x821BE87C stores T=low32(214013*S+2531011); if sampled M is nonzero, 0x821BE894 stores unsigned T modulo M.
loadingTipReceiverBoundary.return: Both local return arms read the upper big-endian halfword of final state and mask to 15 bits: (final_state >> 16) & 0x7FFF, in 0..32767.
loadingTipReceiverBoundary.selection: The accepted caller reduces that return modulo 61 at 0x82E85124..0x82E85130 and reads the pointer at 0x8314F4C8+4*index at 0x82E85140.
loadingTipReceiverBoundary.footprint: The selected leaf has no child call or floating-point operation and no local modulus write. Counter and state are separate ordinary stores, not an atomic snapshot.
loadingTipReceiverBoundary.limits: Actual index, natural invocation count, current tip table/provider and completed string/GFx delivery remain with the glyph owner and are not observed here.

selectedGameHelperBoundary.call: 0x82D2AE00 -> 0x821B2958 with input 16; returned value is forwarded as r4 at 0x82D2AE04 to 0x82D05AD0 at 0x82D2AE0C.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.receiverJoin: 0x821B2968/0x821B2970 forms effective receiver low32(r3)=0x8314F750 and 0x821B2974 calls 0x821B28A0. This is a different generator entry from the tip leaf, with the same actual fixed receiver.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.childOrderedWrites: 0x821B28BC stores low32(C+1); 0x821B28CC stores T=low32(214013*S+2531011); nonzero sampled M selects the unsigned-remainder store at 0x821B28E4.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.childReturn: 0x821B28E8 freshly reloads U32[receiver]; 0x821B28EC loads double Q at receiver+0x10; exact unsigned32-to-double conversion precedes 0x821B28FC's rounded Q*state return in f1.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.childFootprint: No child call or modulus/scale write. 0x821B28F0 writes an eight-byte conversion scratch slot at child SP-16; valid nonalias stack/caller-save storage is required.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.wrapperReturn: Saved input N=zeroExtend32(incoming r3) converts exactly to double at 0x821B2978..0x821B2984. 0x821B2988 multiplies returned f1 by N. 0x821B298C truncates to signed64; 0x821B2994 returns the low32 word zero-extended in r3. Preserve both floating multiplication roundings and native finite/in-range conversion conditions.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.conditionalInput16Range: If child f1 is finite and in [0,1), binary-double multiplication by 16 is exact and truncation returns 0..15. The receipts establish neither actual Q/M values nor that live domain, a uniform distribution, independence or one-in-16 probability.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.sharedSequenceInterpretation: Each selected path consumes one step of the same state/counter under the local guards. A retained intervening tip draw changes which step the later helper consumes; no universal different-return, actual call order or gameplay/world effect is proved.
selectedGameHelperBoundary.remainingGameGates: The accepted selected action/owner/row inputs, both 0x82D05AD0 effects, saved-word restoration meaning, allocation/placement, actual invocation/order and retention remain unproved. The later saved-input request is not proof of restoration.

combatAndSynchronizationDistinction.combatStorage: ordinary-combat-outcome-boundary.json#/overrideCarrierBoundary/carrierRefinement owns the distinct 0x82F7AD00 S+0/C+4/M+8/Q+0x10 carrier. The selected shared-receiver stores do not directly write those cells.
combatAndSynchronizationDistinction.persistence: combat-rng-save-reload-boundary.json#/headerStateTransferBoundary owns the mandatory separate scalar transfer; #/loadPublicationBoundary/stores owns guarded 0x82D8684C -> 0x8314F750 restoration separately from 0x82D86854 -> 0x82F7AD00. Restoration is not a draw. Delivery, body/helper effects and retention retain that owner's conditions.
combatAndSynchronizationDistinction.mainComparison: xbox-network-message-root.json#/turnAndSyncAnchors/case55/seedComparison owns the 0x82CDEC90/94 comparison of 0x82F7AD00 with received arg2, separate from the current-data projection comparison.
combatAndSynchronizationDistinction.limits: No direct selected shared-state-to-world-projection edge, complete RNG isolation, checksum inclusion, peer/clock authority, natural gameplay consequence, actual mismatch cause, resync or recovery is established.

boundedNavigation.qualification: Navigation only. Intervening writes and code ownership are unchecked. The selected wrapper/selector joins above have separate instruction proof; no remaining candidate body was opened and no all-reference or role closure is claimed.

diagnosticProposal.behavior: Passive existing-boundary observation only. Preserve generator/helper call count, inputs, return values and order. No random-service rerun, new command production, state rewrite or behavioral fix is selected.
diagnosticProposal.bounds: Finite owner-set event cap with dropped-event count; overflow/incomplete pairs invalidate sequence-equality conclusions. Keep sessions and current receiver/state generations distinct.
diagnosticProposal.numericMetadata: Site category, event ordinal, opaque session/command/receiver-state generation, existing numeric command/stage, numeric state fingerprints plus before/after equality, counter delta, modulus zero/nonzero, selected tip return/index, wrapper input 16/other, finite-normalized child-return and defined result-range category. Use one compatible comparison scheme for a correlated two-PC capture.
diagnosticProposal.privacyAndValidity: No raw addresses/IDs/handles/names/payloads/retail strings/code/tip tables. Do not follow tip strings, rerun a lookup or dereference invalid/expired storage. Distinguish request, normal return and completed downstream consumption.

UNRUN: enabled/disabled call-count/return/order preservation and later authorized tip/action/save/load/turn gameplay regression.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only radius 0 native word queries, pinned-flat equality, exact-entry generated instruction-comment windows and independent PowerPC operand-comment decode; accepted caller, combat and persistence contracts were reused.

Selected exact generated-entry leaf window; no matching PE row. Neighboring method/padding excluded.

currentEvidence.qualification: Two exact leaf windows lack PE extent metadata; local branch/return closure is interpreted only from selected entries. No runtime observation, initialization closure or global consumer inventory.

requiredDiscriminator: A natural 0..15 claim requires an exact writer or same-generation observation and retention of 0x8314F758 and 0x8314F760..0x8314F767. No exact writer is selected here. Actual gameplay effect needs accepted action/row provenance, same-generation call order and the required 0x82D05AD0 effects at the accepted sites. Incident causality needs runtime observation. Raw materializer candidates alone do not identify those consumers.
guards: Require the supported image, valid nonwrapping ordinary RAM/stack, original native ABI/full register/frame/save/return retention, defined arithmetic and no interfering physical alias/reentrant/concurrent writes.
Keep separate sampled state/counter/modulus/scale generation and ordered writes. Neither helper provides an atomic snapshot or writes modulus/scale.

Do not infer UI-only storage, global RNG coverage, uniformity, fairness, independent trials, combat odds, actual spawning, world-checksum influence, authority or an observed synchronization incident cause.
Keep accepted save-transfer delivery and later retention conditions; restoration requests/stores do not establish a whole-generator save snapshot.
All diagnostics, fake-lifecycle tests, arithmetic models, game and two-PC acceptance remain UNRUN.
conclusion: The selected loading-tip scalar generator and selected native range-helper child advance the same 0x8314F750 state/counter with different return projections. Their storage is distinct from the main combat carrier. Exact selected caller and persistence links are bounded; actual scale/domain, gameplay effects and synchronization causality remain unobserved.
